nc.description: A grey mechanical device features a glowing, dome-shaped light enclosed in a faceted housing that is connected by articulated struts to a cluster of rectangular blocks.
A collection of light grey, interconnected geometric shapes, including a joint with a protruding peg, rests on a white surface.
A light grey, faceted structural component features a central block connecting an angled arm, a horizontal rod, and a flat base.
A light grey mechanical assembly featuring horizontal arms connected to a hinged stack of circular discs is supported by a small wedge resting on a rectangular base.
Grey and white mechanical building components are arranged in a symmetrical pattern radiating outward from a central universal joint on a white background.

vc.description: A grey, 3D-rendered mechanical assembly features a glowing white cylindrical core, a circular base with textured platforms, and an articulated arm ending in two textured pads.
A mechanical linkage system inside a cylindrical housing connects a curved arm to a geared, treaded wheel.
A close-up shows a grey mechanical assembly featuring a ribbed roller, a caliper mechanism, structural arms, and a spiked base plate.
A mechanical assembly features a geared rotary unit connected via a universal joint to a plate from which multiple cables with turnbuckles extend.
A light grey 3D rendering displays a central vehicle suspension assembly surrounded by a symmetrical arrangement of pipes and flanged fittings.
